populations.client_test: the clients' pooled test split (3,262 images), as in Phase 2 and Phase B
populations.buenos_aires: labelled images, the analysis look's seven-class mapping
populations.pad_ufes: labelled images, the analysis look's seven-class mapping

attributes.age_band: silver_metadata.age_approx in bands 0-29, 30-44, 45-59, 60-74, 75+ (lower bound inclusive); missing is unknown
attributes.sex: omop_person.gender_concept_id of the image's person (omop_image_occurrence.image_source_value = ISIC ID); 0 is unknown

group_keys: age bands, and concept IDs written concept:<id>; no vocabulary names

models.probe_seed0, probe_seed1, probe_seed2: the BiomedCLIP linear probe of results/research/b_vlm/spec.json, regenerated from the same embeddings with the same settings and seeds

reproduction_gate: before any subgroup is computed, each model's overall balanced accuracy on each population must equal results/research/b_vlm/results.json to 1e-9, or the run stops and reports nothing
metrics: balanced accuracy (over the classes present in the group), melanoma sensitivity, per-class recall and support (cdm.eval.subgroup_table)
minimums: at least 100 images for a metric, and 100 melanoma images for melanoma sensitivity; smaller groups get counts and a warning
bootstrap: 1000 resamples, seed 0, 95% percentile intervals, within each group; resampling unit: the patient where ISIC records one, else the lesion, else the image
seeds: probe: each seed, and mean and range over the 3 seeds per group

drift.what: Mahalanobis AUROC and FPR@95TPR, the whole client test split against each group of all images (labelled or not) at Buenos Aires and at PAD-UFES-20
drift.efficientnet: the per-image scores saved by the Phase 2 v2 drift run (results/phase2/drift/v2, PCA by method D), 3 seeds, mean and range
drift.biomedclip: Mahalanobis on BiomedCLIP features, PCA size 70 (method D, from the Phase B spec), fit on train

skin_type: not recomputed: results/phase2/analysis_look/skin_type_drift.json and the analysis look's within-site results stand (98 images of types IV to VI in total; no skin-type effect claimed)
comparisons: descriptive only: no test between groups, no threshold or model change; groups differ in class mix, site and imaging type, so a gap between groups is not attributed to the attribute
caveats: HAM10000 and Barcelona record no patient ID, so a person there is a lesion and the sex of a person is the sex recorded on that lesion's images
body site is the finest recorded site; sites with different vocabularies across sources map to different concepts
